svg.title: Web-Queue-Worker
svg.desc: Web-Queue-Worker. A web front end hands slow work to background workers through a queue. Step 1, Two roles and a queue: The web tier saves order 1042, queues a job and replies in ~120 ms; a worker does the ~90 s render. Step 2, Scale each role on its own: Peak: web 2→4 on request rate, workers 1→3 on queue length. At night web shrinks; workers drain. Step 3, State outside the roles: Sessions sit in the cache, so a new web instance knows the user. A crashed job reappears and reruns. Step 4, Know where it stops: Shared schema: a worker change breaks the web tier. The worker becomes a monolith; split it by job.
